name: Tips Music Ltd
title: Tips Music Ltd - 532375 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue up 32% YoY to INR103.9 cr and PAT up 93%, but management attributed it to a repertoire surge with no one-offs; FY27 target is 20% top-line and 20% bottom-line, with content spend guided to INR80–90 cr.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue +32% YoY
triggers.quote: The company recorded quarterly revenue of INR103.9 crores, delivering a YoY growth of 32%.

triggers.label: FY27 target 20% top-line and bottom-line
triggers.quote: our target is to achieve same number 20% on top-line growth and 20% bottom-line growth.
